The official marine forecast is northeast 5-10 kt with light chop. Fresh USGS upstream discharge is ordinary and is retained only as a lagged regional forcing proxy. Opportunity is Point Clear 3-8% and Daphne/May Day 2-6%; no alert gate is met.

Fresh owner/public views show no scoped biological or coordinated human signal, river forcing is not exceptional, and the decisive local bottom/contact-strip oxygen state remains unknown.

daphne_may_day.basis: Northeast flow and a rising tide are modest positives, but Point Clear-specific NGOFS2 guidance does not establish Daphne transport.
